title: Oily Outrageous Sardinian Fish Sauce Orecchiette
description: A sour and gooey Sardinian dish featuring fish sauce, orecchiette pasta, and a blend of Italian flavors, this recipe is egg-free and perfect for a show-off dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the orecchiette pasta according to the package instructions until al dente
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant
Add the chopped anchovy fillets to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the fish sauce to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently
Stir in the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute
Add the cooked orecchiette pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the fish sauce mixture
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated parmesan cheese and chopped parsley
Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired and serve immediately
